ENGINEERING
WITH PURPOSE.

Established in 2019, Elecnic Projects Pvt. Ltd. is a specialized MEP contracting company based in India. We deliver complete end-to-end solutions across Electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, Fire Fighting, ELV, and IBMS systems for commercial, corporate, and industrial projects.

Driven by a strong commitment to quality, safety, and timely execution, Elecnic focuses on reliable and technically sound MEP installations.
